title: S1716 (2025 Regular): Sale and Delivery of Firearms

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2025-02-28; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2025/1716/BillText/Filed/HTML (LegiScan doc 3147730))
provenance.note: Introduced version (2025-02-28). All text of subsection (13) is struck, nothing is added, so no law text remains to quote; the quote is the amending clause. Struck: age 21 purchase ban, dealer sale/transfer ban, third-degree felony penalty, and the exemption for law enforcement/correctional officers and servicemembers.

operative_text:
Section 1 (s. 790.065, F.S.): Subsection (13) of section 790.065, Florida Statutes, is amended to read:
Section 1 (s. 790.065(13), F.S.), words struck by the bill (the whole subsection is shown struck in the filed text; read from the saved official HTML 2026-11-22): (13) A person younger than 21 years of age may not purchase a firearm. The sale or transfer of a firearm to a person younger than 21 years of age may not be made or facilitated by a licensed importer, licensed manufacturer, or licensed dealer.
